title: Weave a Title
narrative: The gate answers only to a traveller named properly. Take the first name from a full name, and weave it into a title fit for the door.
instructions:
The System provides `full_name` and `rank`. Do not assign either yourself.

- Take the FIRST word of `full_name`.
- Weave it into this exact sentence and store it in `title_card`: `<first> the <rank>`

With `full_name = "Kael Ash"` and `rank = "Brave"`, `title_card` is `"Kael the Brave"`.
starting_code:
# `full_name` and `rank` are provided by the System (do not reassign them).
# Take the first word of full_name, then weave: <first> the <rank>

first = 

title_card =
hints: Split the full name into words with `full_name.split()`.
Take the first word with `[0]`: `first = full_name.split()[0]`.
Weave it with an f-string: `title_card = f"{first} the {rank}"`.
A name with only one word splits into a one-item list, so [0] still gives that single name.
